1. The rms speed of molecules of a gas is directly proportional to the square root of the absolute temperature of the gas.

2. The rms speed of molecules of different gases at the same temperature is inversely proportional to the square root of the molecular mass, i.e., the higher the molecular mass, the lesser the rms speed at the same temperature.
